claimBoundary: Formal compiler proof skeleton only; open obligations remain and compiler correctness is not proved.
nonClaims: R10E is a formal proof skeleton, not a completed compiler proof.

reviewHighlights: Maps R10C scoped certificates into a compiler proof skeleton.
